content.short: Arbiscan is an Arbitrum blockchain explorer.
content.description: Arbiscan is a blockchain explorer for the Arbitrum network. It lets users view their balances and on-chain transactions on Arbitrum, while providing insights into transfers, addresses, tokens, prices and other activity on the network. Developers can access Arbitrum transaction data, address and token information, and related on-chain activity to support their dapps. Arbiscan is the leading block explorer for the Arbitrum network and is designed exclusively for Arbitrum.
